Based on extensive, peer-reviewed scientific literature analyzing the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES) data, there are **no** cycles in which PFOA (LBXPFOA) shows a negative within-cycle association with total cholesterol (LBXTC).

In every cycle where PFOA was measured, the association has been consistently and statistically significantly **positive**.

The specific cycles where this positive association has been documented are:
*   1999-2000
*   2003-2004
*   2005-2006
*   2007-2008
*   2009-2010
*   2011-2012
*   2013-2014
*   2015-2016
*   2017-2018
